Redwood workforce structures pages in 26D

From the 26D update, 5 Oracle Fusion HCM workforce structures pages open in Redwood by default: Departments, Enterprise HCM Information, Grade Ladders, Jobs and Locations. The older responsive or classic pages are no longer shown by default, but you can still use them by setting the profile option to No.

Oracle sources: Oracle 26D What's New: Redwood Enabled by Default for Workforce Structures Pages · Oracle 26C What's New: Redwood Enabled by Default for Workforce Structures Pages in Update 26D

Checked against Oracle's pages on 2026-10-19. Oracle can revise its What's New pages; always confirm on the linked Oracle page.

How to keep the older pages for now

Oracle lets you switch each page back by setting its profile option to No:

  1. In Setup and Maintenance, open the Manage Administrator Profile Values task.
  2. Search for the profile option code from the table above.
  3. In Profile Values, enter No and save.

Per Oracle, if you set a profile option to Yes in a test pod and then back to No to stay on the older page, that No is kept when the pod moves to 26D. The setting is held separately in each pod, so check production as well as every test pod.

Oracle keeps the full list of HCM Redwood profile options in My Oracle Support: HCM Redwood Pages with Profile Options (Doc ID 2922407.1).

What to check before 26D reaches your test pod

  • Access: per Oracle, the roles that could open the responsive and classic pages can open the Redwood pages too.
  • Have the people who maintain jobs, departments and locations run their usual create and update tasks on the Redwood pages in your test environment.
  • Decide whether any page needs its profile option set to No for now, in each pod.
